verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Svelte components are written in HTML, CSS and JavaScript. A single component holds a `<script>` block (JS, or TS via `lang="ts"`), markup, and a `<style>` block whose CSS is scoped to that component. Community reports independently confirm the single-file component model (even a critic acknowledges it) and compare it to Vue's script setup. missing for 10: the template control-flow syntax (e.g. `{#if}` blocks) is Svelte-specific rather than plain HTML/JS, and one user describes Svelte as effectively a JS superset, so 'a language I already know' is not entirely seamless.
